critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: /app/backend/routes/whatsapp.py — toggle_star used `if not m:` after `find_one({'id':message_id}, {'_id':0,'starred':1})`. When the document existed but had no `starred` field, MongoDB returned `{}` which is falsy, incorrectly raising 404. Changed to `if m is None:` (same defensive fix applied to toggle_pin for symmetry). Verified by real API call: 5000012 which existed in DB returned 404 before the fix and 200 after. Users would previously never be able to star a message the first time.

whatsapp.py list_channels `search` builds regex on `phone_digits` unanchored — could match longer numbers ending with the query digits. Low impact for Indian 10-digit numbers but flagged again from iter32.

wa_cloud.py webhook picks channel by regex `phone_digits + '$'` without sort — non-deterministic when multiple channels end with the same 10 digits. Consider indexing on phone_digits and matching most-recently-active.
toggle_react endpoint stores emoji verbatim without length/validation cap — consider limiting to a single grapheme.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The `if not m` truthiness bug in toggle_star/toggle_pin has been fixed. If touching those endpoints again, keep `is None`. Preview WhatsApp Cloud is still fully configured (access_token + phone_number_id set) so free-text sends within the 24h session window actually go through Meta. The Interested category flow requires the channel's phone_digits to exactly match a lead's phone_digits (both 10 digits, last 10 of msisdn) — seed both accordingly. Category set to 'interested' will run on_tag_set automations for the linked lead — be aware of side effects.
rca of the issue: Bug: POST /api/whatsapp/messages/{id}/star returned 404 'Message not found' for every message that had never been starred before. Root cause: find_one used projection `{_id:0, starred:1}` — MongoDB returns `{}` (empty dict) when the projected field isn't in the doc; empty dict is falsy in Python; `if not m` triggered HTTP 404. Repro: create a fresh wa_message (any inbound), POST /star → 404. Fix: change `if not m:` to `if m is None:` in toggle_star and toggle_pin (same latent risk). Verified fixed via manual curl and pytest run.
